stem:
Gita asks whether roughage and water count in the diet if they are not called vitamins.

What should she decide?

options.text: They are the same as proteins.
They are essential diet components even though they are not the vitamin group.
Water is needed only in winter.
Roughage can be skipped if the plate looks full.

teacher.key_rationale: Roughage and water are essential diet components, distinct from proteins and vitamins. Season and a full-looking plate do not drop them.
